findings.title: Picking debits can commit without dispatched state
findings.currentBehavior: Each stock movement is awaited individually; compensation covers only errors inside debit loop. persistPicking runs after that catch. Failure there reaches outer fail(), which reloads picking and stock but does not compensate successful debits. Reverse path likewise uses multiple writes.
findings.expectedBehavior: One authoritative transactional/idempotent command links ledger, picking and reservation consumption.
findings.problem: Picking debits can commit without dispatched state
findings.businessImpact: Retry after partial failure can repeat stock debit; inventory and dispatch status diverge.
findings.demoImpact: Retry after partial failure can repeat stock debit; inventory and dispatch status diverge.
findings.technicalImpact: Each stock movement is awaited individually; compensation covers only errors inside debit loop. persistPicking runs after that catch. Failure there reaches outer fail(), which reloads picking and stock but does not compensate successful debits. Reverse path likewise uses multiple writes.
findings.recommendation: Move dispatch transition and ledger effects into atomic server command; test failure after final debit and retry without duplicate debit.
dependencies: Backend and browser failure-injection evidence for exact command
findings.runtimeStatus: NEEDS VERIFICATION; no test execution in this worker

findings.title: Team step-up cancellation still reports command success
findings.currentBehavior: stepUp.run resolves null on cancel or MFA-required. Roles, admin transfer and revoke-session handlers discard result and show success. Offboard skips only cache update on null but still executes outer success toast and closes dialog.
findings.expectedBehavior: Cancelled or unmet MFA must preserve the action without claiming completion; only committed result triggers success.
findings.problem: Team step-up cancellation still reports command success
findings.businessImpact: Operator can believe sessions were revoked or membership ended while server action never happened.
findings.demoImpact: Operator can believe sessions were revoked or membership ended while server action never happened.
findings.technicalImpact: stepUp.run resolves null on cancel or MFA-required. Roles, admin transfer and revoke-session handlers discard result and show success. Offboard skips only cache update on null but still executes outer success toast and closes dialog.
findings.recommendation: Return an explicit executed/cancelled result through mutation wrapper; gate all outer success side effects. Add cancellation and MFA-required tests for all four commands.
dependencies: Backend and browser failure-injection evidence for exact command
findings.runtimeStatus: NEEDS VERIFICATION; no test execution in this worker

findings.title: Catalog and settings failures masquerade as legitimate empty/default data
findings.currentBehavior: getCatalog catches structures/components/agregados/ambient/material-category request failures and supplies empty arrays. getWorkshopSettings maps non-OK and thrown errors to defaults. This includes outages/authorization failures, not just missing legacy endpoints.
findings.expectedBehavior: Expose typed unavailable/error state and preserve last confirmed data rather than silently substituting empty/default configuration.
findings.problem: Catalog and settings failures masquerade as legitimate empty/default data
findings.businessImpact: Demo can display an empty catalog or incorrect default financial/manufacturing settings instead of the actual failure.
findings.demoImpact: Demo can display an empty catalog or incorrect default financial/manufacturing settings instead of the actual failure.
findings.technicalImpact: getCatalog catches structures/components/agregados/ambient/material-category request failures and supplies empty arrays. getWorkshopSettings maps non-OK and thrown errors to defaults. This includes outages/authorization failures, not just missing legacy endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Remove broad silent fallback; distinguish deliberate optional availability from failed required data; test 403/500/network/parse failures and rendered recovery.
dependencies: Backend and browser failure-injection evidence for exact command
findings.runtimeStatus: NEEDS VERIFICATION; no test execution in this worker

findings.title: Settings shows saved before persistence finishes
findings.currentBehavior: SettingsScreen onSave has void signature and is not awaited; immediately sets savedFlash. Shell async save can later report error and store rolls back, so contradictory success/error feedback occurs.
findings.expectedBehavior: Show pending while saving; success only after authoritative save; retain editable input and failure feedback.
findings.problem: Settings shows saved before persistence finishes
findings.businessImpact: Changes appear saved during slow or failed network; undermines trust in workshop settings.
findings.demoImpact: Changes appear saved during slow or failed network; undermines trust in workshop settings.
findings.technicalImpact: SettingsScreen onSave has void signature and is not awaited; immediately sets savedFlash. Shell async save can later report error and store rolls back, so contradictory success/error feedback occurs.
findings.recommendation: Use Promise-returning save prop with pending state; stop swallowing outcome at shell boundary; await before saved flash. Preserve existing rollback.
dependencies: Backend and browser failure-injection evidence for exact command
findings.runtimeStatus: NEEDS VERIFICATION; no test execution in this worker

findings.title: Purchasing uses first role instead of granted role union
findings.currentBehavior: AppContent actorRole is actorRoles[0]; ShellView passes it to PurchasingScreen. canMarkPicked checks only null/admin/almacen; stock/purchasing controls derive from it. Shell handlers already use union.
findings.expectedBehavior: UI capabilities must match union of effective roles; role ordering must not hide permitted actions.
findings.problem: Purchasing uses first role instead of granted role union
findings.businessImpact: Multi-role staff can reach workspace but lose stock/dispatch/PO controls depending on first role. This is a UI denial, not evidence of server authorization bypass.
findings.demoImpact: Multi-role staff can reach workspace but lose stock/dispatch/PO controls depending on first role. This is a UI denial, not evidence of server authorization bypass.
findings.technicalImpact: AppContent actorRole is actorRoles[0]; ShellView passes it to PurchasingScreen. canMarkPicked checks only null/admin/almacen; stock/purchasing controls derive from it. Shell handlers already use union.
findings.recommendation: Pass explicit canMarkPicked/canManagePurchasing capabilities (or roles union), with role-order permutation tests.
dependencies: Backend and browser failure-injection evidence for exact command
